pre_admission_conditions: bounded published claim that can be challenged
downloadable public raw data with real content artifact
reproducible baseline or explicit code and method
named artifact confounder reconciliation or robustness boundary
independent partition replication paired design or reconciliation structure
meaningful positive null and contrary consequence
self-contained interpretation without unavailable specialist judgment

seed_patterns.design_signal: Replicated baseline and derived-change measurements permit a shared-measurement or regression-to-the-mean check.
seed_patterns.required_structure: Raw repeated baseline and later measurement blocks, a published baseline, and a disjoint or cross-fit partition.

seed_patterns.design_signal: Repeated units have an exposure that can be decomposed into within-unit and between-unit components.
seed_patterns.required_structure: Stable unit identifiers, repeated exposures and outcomes, an explicit published association, and a feasible within-unit comparison.

seed_patterns.design_signal: Independently assembled evidence tables retain source provenance and potential matching links.
seed_patterns.required_structure: At least two public source tables, source-level identifiers, a published synthesis baseline, and a predeclared reconciliation protocol.

seed_patterns.design_signal: A randomized or quasi-randomized cluster intervention has repeated outcome measurements and an independent cluster/time check.
seed_patterns.required_structure: Documented treatment assignment, cluster identifiers, repeated outcome rows, a published endpoint claim, and holdout-capable groups.

seed_patterns.design_signal: A diagnostic or measurement method is evaluated across documented physical conditions or specimens.
seed_patterns.required_structure: Condition-labelled raw measurements, a published diagnostic baseline, separately evaluable specimens, and an independent condition or unit holdout.

reference_cases.restriction: It is a completed historical investigation and may not be re-emitted as a seed or candidate.

quality_measure: Among only seeds pre-admitted on all seven conditions, measure the fraction that reach a complete candidate packet after full audit; do not use broad-hit volume, survival, or scientific outcome as a score.
prohibited_next_step: Do not run another broad-topic discovery funnel or send a seed to System 2 before it becomes a complete candidate packet.
next_permitted_action: Search the five design patterns for sources with preliminary evidence for all seven conditions and assemble five to eight pre-admitted seeds before full audit.
